first.rationale: With onboarding completion down 4% and activation down 6%, simplifying onboarding directly addresses both deteriorating leading indicators and has the strongest expected sustainable-revenue pathway through faster time-to-value and adoption. Verify the onboarding result because it is central to the chosen intervention, and verify promotional-pricing evidence because competitor pricing makes it the consequential alternative but discounting can create downstream revenue-quality and margin risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified prior result directly improves the two declining indicators—onboarding completion and time-to-value—and produced a +3% 30-day retention lift, making it the strongest sustainable qualified-revenue path. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified +18% qualified-revenue lift was paired with -12% 30-day retention and failure to survive the first renewal cycle, creating unacceptable downstream value risk despite competitor pressure.
